title: About us — Supreme Art
description: Supreme Art is a Peshawar-based manufacturer of pharmaceutical folding cartons, running the whole process — prepress, printing, die-cutting, folding and gluing — in-house.

intro.heading: The paper box your medicine comes in — made under one roof.
paragraphs: Supreme Art (Pvt) Ltd is a Peshawar-based manufacturer of pharmaceutical folding cartons. From the first proof to the flat-packed, glued carton on your filling line, every stage of production happens in our own facility.
We work with pharmaceutical brands who need packaging that is accurate, consistent and traceable — because for medicine, the box is part of patient safety.

items.title: Get it right
items.text: Documented checks at every stage, so every carton meets pharma standards.

items.title: To the millimetre
items.text: Clean cuts, crisp creases and colour that stays consistent across runs.

items.title: Traceable & reliable
items.text: Full batch traceability and timelines you can plan production around.

items.title: Decades in print
items.text: An experienced team that treats every job like it carries our name.

cta.heading: Have a carton to make?
cta.text: Send us your artwork or dieline — we'll come back with a quote and a timeline.
